zh.title: 波音略過EASA認證 737 MAX 7延後取得認證
zh.summary: 波音略過EASA認證；737 MAX 7將延後取得認證；西南航空為主要營運者
body: 波音（Boeing）在2026年8月22日發布的報導中，表示其737 MAX 7機型目前略過了歐洲航空安全局（EASA）的認證程序。
根據Simple Flying的報導，該機型將「幾乎完全由西南航空（Southwest Airlines）營運」，因此波音決定先行專注於美國聯邦航空局（FAA）的認證流程。
波音在7月份已完成737 MAX 7與MAX 10的認證飛行測試，並預期2026年取得認證，2027年首架交付。
本次決策反映出波音在認證策略上的調整，特別是針對主要客戶西南航空的營運需求。

en.title: Boeing Skips EASA Approval For 737 MAX 7 For Now
en.summary: Boeing skips EASA approval for 737 MAX 7; Southwest Airlines to be main operator
body: Boeing has decided to skip European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) approval for the 737 MAX 7 for now, according to a report published on August 22, 2026.
The report by Simple Flying states that the aircraft will be operated almost entirely by Southwest Airlines, leading Boeing to focus first on U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification.
As of July, Boeing had completed certification flight testing on both the 737-7 and 737-10, with certification anticipated in 2026 and first delivery in 2027.
This decision reflects an adjustment in Boeing's certification strategy, particularly aligned with the operational needs of its primary customer, Southwest Airlines.
